title: Nonconformances
purpose: Find issues, assignments, due dates and corrective action status.
summary: Find nonconformances: the issues the lab is investigating or has closed, who owns them, when they are due and where they stand.

tasks.title: Find a nonconformance
steps: Type an NC number, title, sample ID, asset ID, lot number or material in [[Search]], then select [[Apply]].
Select the number to open the record.

tasks.title: See the open issues assigned to you
steps: Set [[Status]] to Not closed and [[Owner]] to Assigned to me, then select [[Apply]].

tasks.title: Report a new issue
steps: Select [[New nonconformance]]. Any lab staff member can report one.

good_to_know: Closed records are listed too unless you set [[Status]] to Not closed.
Past due means not closed and due before today. A due date of today is not past due.
Severity is the choice recorded on the issue. The application does not assign it.
Owner, category, corrective action and notes are not searched.

sections.title: Access and navigation
paragraphs: Available to active signed-in lab staff with an admin, custodian, analyst, reviewer, approver or project manager role. Client accounts and accounts without a lab role cannot open laboratory pages. Sidebar links open Lab overview, Inventory, Equipment, Training and Nonconformances. Breadcrumbs return to the list or parent record.

items.label: New nonconformance
items.description: All lab staff can report an issue. Open Number to read details and timeline.

items.label: Search
items.description: Case-insensitive search across title, original description and root cause, sample lab ID, asset ID, lot number and material name. Numeric search also matches nonconformance ID or batch ID; NC-000123 searches number 123. Owner, category, corrective action, notes and evidence content are not searched.

items.label: Status
items.description: All statuses is default, including Closed. Not closed excludes Closed; individual choices are Open, Investigating, Corrective action, Verification and Closed.

items.label: Severity
items.description: All severities by default; Minor, Major or Critical; the application does not assign thresholds for these choices.

items.label: Owner
items.description: Any owner by default; Assigned to me or Unassigned.

items.label: Category
items.description: Under More filters; All categories or Sample, Batch / QC, Equipment, Standard / reagent, Personnel / training, Procedure / documentation or Other.

items.label: Due
items.description: Under More filters; All or Overdue only. Overdue requires nonclosed status and due date before today. Due today and records without a due date are not overdue.

items.label: Number
items.description: Generated NC identifier and detail link, always visible. Default sort is newest number first.

items.label: Title
items.description: Issue summary.

items.label: Severity
items.description: Recorded severity; Major is highlighted and Critical receives a stronger alert.

items.label: Status
items.description: Current workflow step.

items.label: Linked records
items.description: Sample ID, batch number, material/lot and asset ID, or dash; not sortable.

items.label: Owner
items.description: Assigned person or Unassigned; sorting uses username.

items.label: Due
items.description: Entered due date with Past due when nonclosed and before today, or dash.

items.label: Discovered
items.description: Discovery date; initially hidden. First click sorts newest first.

items.label: Apply
items.description: Apply search and filters to all records, keeping sort and page size and returning to page 1. Search is case-insensitive and limited to 200 characters.

items.label: More filters
items.description: Open additional filters where available. Opens automatically for active additional filters or filter errors.

items.label: Active filters
items.description: Remove a chip to clear that filter and return to page 1. Clear all restores the unfiltered list; your saved sort and rows per page stay. The default 30-day window is not an active filter.

items.label: Column headings
items.description: Sortable headings order the full matching list and toggle direction. Ties use record ID ascending. Plain headings cannot sort. Invalid sort parameters use the default. Changing sort returns to page 1. Most headings start ascending; date/high-quantity exceptions are described under Columns. Text and stored-choice sorting is alphabetical, not an assessment of urgency or laboratory priority.

items.label: Rows per page
items.description: Choose 25, 50 or 100, default 25. Show applies when automatic submission is unavailable. First, Previous, Next and Last keep filters and sort. The footer shows range and total. Invalid page text opens page 1; an out-of-range number opens the last page. Unsupported page sizes are rejected.

items.label: Columns
items.description: When table enhancement is available, check columns to show them or uncheck to hide them. Changes apply immediately and are saved for your account, on any workstation. Use Move … up or Move … down controls, or drag headings. The identity column is Always shown and cannot move or hide. Reset columns restores the initial layout. Close or Done closes the dialog. These preferences do not change records, filters, sorting or paging. If the change cannot be saved, the layout applies only to this page.

sections.title: Empty and invalid states
paragraphs: Invalid filters show These filters cannot be applied and no rows; correct the highlighted filter or clear it. No matches shows a filtered empty state. An empty unfiltered list explains what to create; create actions follow your role. There are no row selections or bulk actions.

sections.title: Who can change this record
paragraphs: Any lab staff member can open a nonconformance, read it and add notes/evidence, including after closure. Only its assigned owner or an admin, reviewer, approver or project manager role can edit details or drive workflow. Opening a record does not by itself give the opener management rights. Staff selectors list active non-client accounts, ordered by username, with full name and username when available.

sections.title: Workflow and limits
paragraphs: The fixed flow is Open, Investigating, Corrective action, Verification, Closed. Steps cannot be skipped. Verification can return to Corrective action; Closed can reopen to Investigating, each with a reason. Severity and disposition are recorded choices; the system does not infer them. A linked issue or a disposition such as Hold or Qualify does not automatically hold a batch, qualify a result, retire equipment, alter stock or block report release. Apply any separate operational controls explicitly. There is no required independent verifier rule in this workflow; the owner or lead can verify and close.
